reviews.title: All style and little substance. Glaring interface gaps make this not worth the price
reviews.text: Have been using for about half a year now and while there is a lot to like, the seemingly obvious gaps in interface options are irritating enough to have me looking elsewhere. The inability to choose what time intervals you want your constant reminder in (and the fact that they are not constant) seems almost …insane considering what the point of the app is, if your task can’t be completed in 5 minutes with a very loud alarm going off every 30 seconds good luck. Being able to have an hourly reminder for tasks that may take the whole day feels so obvious and yet they’ve chosen to not offer that despite their user’s requests. Not being able to organize my daily list by newest to oldest… i mean… just why?? Why would i not be able to do that? It feels like they’ve made their product and have zero interest in making sure it is able to help with any kind of diverse task management. Oh also if you have multiple tasks with reminders set at the same time your push notification will just say “3 tasks” instead of what they are… and no option to change that, what gives? All style and no substance sums up my experience with this app
